definitions.full: H7730. sobek שׂוֺבֶךְ noun [masculine] network of boughs ; — construct ׳שׂ הָאֵלָה 2Sam 18:9 .

occurrences.englishText: Absalom happened to meet David’s servants. Absalom was riding on his mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the sky and earth; and the mule that was under him went on.
